d:
Machine translated this doujin, but also tried to add in some outside research (finding out what specific kanji meant so I can add in a better translation than the AI, etc.). Was waiting for more than a year for it to get translated, but I had enough of the wait and took matters into my own hands.
Please leave any note on the typesetting/editing, I'm tryna improve on that front.
Expunged the previous gallery due to a fuck-up, mixing the location of two pages, posting the untranslated ones to the previous gallery. Oops.
